notes: Created comprehensive 4-phase implementation plan for undo/redo expansion. Phase 1: Fix title move/resize closure bug. Phase 2: Image operations (add, remove, clear all) with disposed-image guard. Phase 3: Layout changes (style + batched options). Phase 4: Title & styling (text blur/Enter, formatting per-toggle, style batched, background, overlay). Introduced onUndoCommand callback pattern (Option A) for handler decoupling. Included Given-When-Then scenarios at user behavior, unit test, and E2E levels for each phase. Consulted @world-review for UX analysis and @explore for codebase research.
